figures.shows: Spatial maps of the PAH fraction R_PAH in four PHANGS galaxies (IC 5332, NGC 628, NGC 1365, NGC 7496), with contours marking bright HII regions that appear as depressions in R_PAH.
readable_values: approx. 5 kpc scale bar in each panel
approx. HII-region contours appear as local R_PAH depressions in NGC 628 and NGC 7496
figures.caption_quote: Maps of RPAH in IC 5332 (top left), NGC 628 (top right), NGC 1365 (bottom left), and NGC 7496 (bottom right).

figures.shows: Running medians of R_PAH versus r/r25, metallicity 12+log(O/H), ionized-to-total gas surface density ratio, molecular gas fraction, and environmental mask categories for four galaxies.
readable_values: approx. R_PAH about 4.5 at centre of NGC 628 and 4.9 at bar
approx. R_PAH about 1.0 at r/r25 near 0.9 in NGC 7496
approx. R_PAH about 5.5 peak in NGC 1365 at r/r25 near 0.3
approx. R_PAH about 2.5 to 3.0 for IC 5332 at r/r25 near 0.5
figures.caption_quote: Running medians of RPAH, as a function of (top left:) r/r25; (top right:) 12 + log(O/H) using metallicity maps from Williams et al. (2022)

figures.shows: 2D histograms of R_PAH versus the ionized-to-total gas surface density ratio, colour-coded by metallicity, for four galaxies with running medians overlaid.
readable_values: approx. R_PAH about 4.9 peak in NGC 628 near log10 ratio 37.5
approx. R_PAH about 5.2 peak in NGC 1365 near log10 ratio 37.1
figures.caption_quote: 2D histograms of the IHα/ΣHI+H2 and the RPAH, color-coded by metallicity, using the gradient from PHANGS- MUSE.

figures.shows: Maps of R_PAH for four galaxies colour-coded by Querejeta et al. (2021) environmental masks: centre, bar, interarm, spiral arms and disk.
figures.caption_quote: RPAH maps colored by the environmental masks from Querejeta et al. (2021): center in red, bar in green, interarms in gray, spiral arms in blue and disk in orange.
